record.question: I will go if he comes.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. “If he comes” gives the condition under which I will go, an adverb clause (B). Independent check: “If he comes” is a conditional clause modifying “will go,” so it is adverbial. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
